title: Yoko Ono locates her estranged daughter Kyoko | 1971
content:
Yoko Ono located her estranged seven-year-old daughter Kyoko on 20 April 1971.

Kyoko was living on the Spanish island Mallorca with with her father Tony Cox and his wife Melinda.

Lennon and Ono had arrived in Mallorca the previous day with their assistant Dan Richter. On this day Richter drove them to a hotel complex in Cala Murada on the southeastern coast, where Ono was taken inside to meet Kyoko and Tony Cox. Ono was told details of Kyoko’s daycare arrangements and break times, which she later used in an attempt to take Kyoko back to England.

On this date Lennon and Ono stayed in room 1416 at the Hotel Bellver in Palma de Mallorca, booked under the name Mr and Mrs Curtis.
